subject.title: Prefer chat names in agent session labels

question: Should existing Descriptive-mode agent-session labels change from task-first to chat-first for guardian and subagent sessions?
rationale: The current merged feature deliberately established task-oriented labels for these session types; choosing a new display precedence is a user-facing product policy rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Adopt chat-first labels
options.body: Accept the proposed chat-title-first ordering while retaining task context, fallbacks, and the fixed menu-length cap.

options.title: Keep task-first labels
options.body: Preserve the current guardian and subagent ordering and close or narrow this follow-up as an alternative UX preference.

recommendation.title: Adopt chat-first labels
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed chat-title-first ordering while retaining task context, fallbacks, and the fixed menu-length cap.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged descriptive-label behavior and are the strongest available history-based routing candidate for clarifying the intended label policy.
